title: Dynamic Regular Witnesses for Near-Exact State Complexity of Explicit Binary Consensus with Periodic Time
creator: Yonezu, Ryutaro
description: We study deterministic binary consensus with explicit termination in anonymous synchronous 1-interval-connected dynamic networks under one-bit broadcast-counting communication with a free globally aligned phase phi_t=t mod P. For every n>=15, we prove 2+ceil((n-13)/P) <= S_n(n,P) <= 2+ceil((n-1)/P). For even n>=12, the lower numerator improves to n-10. We also prove the exact minimum-state saturation threshold S_n(n,P)=3 iff P>=n-1 for n>=4. The full exact formula for arbitrary state budgets is not claimed. This record is a preprint and has not been peer reviewed.
